lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2TlAg crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Ba8Tl4Ag4) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Ag and Tl centers each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Ba centers show 16 neighbors; Ag and Tl environments involve mixed Ag/Ba/Tl coordination. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ba and Tl polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ba and Ag polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic network.
